name: kpi-gamification
description: Create gamecards, HR Kits, SOPs and HR policy drafts for your company, and check how your company uses KPI Gamification, from a conversation. Everything is previewed first and saved only after you confirm.

author.name: Revelation Management Consulting India Pvt Ltd

interface.longDescription: KPI Gamification turns KPIs into a daily game for your Team Members. Connect your company admin account to design a gamecard for any role, build its HR Kit, write your SOPs, draft your HR policy and see how well your company is using KPI Gamification. Every item is previewed first and saved only after you confirm. HR policies are saved as drafts and never published. The connector cannot manage users, roles or billing, and it never reads an individual Team Member's data.
interface.developerName: Revelation Management Consulting India Pvt Ltd
defaultPrompt: Create a gamecard for a retail sales executive.
Build the HR Kit for one of our gamecards.
How is our company doing on KPI Gamification?
